validation.message: Survey title must be between 3 and 100 characters

fields.name: surveyDescription
fields.label: Survey Description
fields.placeholder: Provide a brief description of the survey purpose and objectives

validation.message: Description must be between 10 and 500 characters

title: Notification Template
description: Create and edit notification templates for automated communications

validation.message: Template name must be between 3 and 100 characters
Subject line must not exceed 200 characters

fields.placeholder: Enter your message template. Use {{variable}} for dynamic content (e.g., {{respondent_name}}, {{survey_link}})

validation.message: Message body must be between 10 and 5000 characters

validation.message: Name must be between 3 and 100 characters
